name: [EASY MODE]AOONI Nightmare
desc:
The smash-hit horror IP 'AOONI' arrives on ROBLOX!  "A blue monster appears."

-Update
added Underground Stage on Sep 30.
added Become Aooni Mode（SPIDER Ver.）on July 9.
added Become Aooni Mode（SQUATTO Ver.）on May 29.
added Become Aooni Mode（FUWATTY Ver.）on April 30.
added Become Aooni Mode（=PvP mode）on Mar 31.

-Story
You were living a peaceful school life, but suddenly you are trapped in a nightmare school where a blue monster appears. It seems that you cannot escape from here unless you complete the "classes" of this school. Cooperate with your classmates and survive together!

-Controls
Shift key to sprint
Space key to jump

-Recommendation
Max graphics setting recommended
Headphone recommended
The game contains mild horror elements.

-Note
